parts.label: i
parts.text: (e) (i) The sum of two positive integers is S . S is an even number. Find an expression, in terms of S , for the largest product of the two integers. ......................................................

content.tex: The sum of two positive integers is \(S\) . \(S\) is an even number.
Find an expression, in terms of \(S\) , for the largest product of the two integers.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The sum of two positive integers is 62. Find the largest product of the two integers. ......................................................

content.tex: The sum of two positive integers is 62.
Find the largest product of the two integers.

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) The sum of two positive integers is S . S is an even number. The largest product of the two integers is 576. Find the value of S . ......................................................

content.tex: The sum of two positive integers is \(S\) . \(S\) is an even number. The largest product of the two integers is 576.
